subject: Where is my bike?
body:
Hi — I ordered a Commuter S last week (order RW-10510) and the confirmation said it shipped, but I still don't have a clear delivery day. Can you tell me where it is and when I should expect it?

Thanks,
Jonah

subject: I'd like a refund
body:
Hello, I need to return my Ridgeway Commuter S and get a refund. It's too large for the storage in my building. Order RW-10482. I only rode it around the block. Please send a return label if that's how this works.

Maya Chen

subject: Item arrived damaged
body:
The Trail 5 showed up today and the box was crushed on one corner. The derailleur hanger is bent and there's a gouge on the downtube. I have photos of the box and the bike. Order RW-10522. I haven't ridden it. I need this replaced — I don't want a damaged bike.

Luis

subject: Refund for the cargo bike
body:
Hi, I want my money back on RW-10440. The Cargo Mk2 isn't getting as much use as I thought. I know it's been a while since it arrived in August, but I'm asking anyway.

Priya

subject: Missing charger
body:
My Commuter S arrived but the charger wasn't in the box, and I don't see a second package. I can't use the bike. Order RW-10391. Can you send the charger out today?

Hannah

subject: Battery warranty
body:
The battery on my Commuter S (serial RW-C-770441, order RW-10115) is dropping from full to empty in about 8 miles. It used to do 35+. Can you start a warranty claim? Happy to send photos and the cycle count from the display.

Owen

subject: Please cancel my order
body:
Please cancel order RW-10531. I found a used bike locally and don't need the step-through anymore. I ordered it yesterday so I'm hoping it hasn't shipped.

Sofia

subject: Cancel RW-10518
body:
I need to cancel my Trail 5 order RW-10518. Plans changed. Please stop it if you can and refund me.

Chris

subject: Returning the custom cargo
body:
I'd like to return the custom cargo bike (RW-10401) for a refund. The color isn't what I expected in daylight. It arrived last week.

Elena

subject: This is taking forever
body:
RW-10488 has been stuck in Chicago according to UPS for almost two weeks. The site said 5–8 business days. I still don't have a bike and tracking hasn't moved. This is ridiculous. What are you going to do about it?

Marcus Hill

subject: Return unused panniers
body:
The pannier set doesn't fit the rack I already own. They're unopened. Order RW-10504. I'd like to send them back for a refund.

Nina

subject: Motor cut out after I washed the bike
body:
Warranty question — I pressure washed the Trail 5 after a muddy ride and now the motor cuts out. Order RW-10220 from a couple years ago. Can you replace the controller under warranty?

Tom

subject: Has my order shipped?
body:
Hi, just checking on RW-10527. I ordered the black step-through two days ago and haven't seen a tracking number yet. No rush, just curious.

Ava

subject: NEED THIS BEFORE SATURDAY
body:
I ordered RW-10512 for a wedding this Saturday (Oct 18). Tracking still says in transit. I need this bike Friday at the latest or I have a real problem. Please do something — overnight it, intercept it, anything.

Ben

subject: Wrong size arrived
body:
I ordered a Trail 5 but the bike that arrived is a small and I need a medium. The confirmation for RW-10495 said medium. Can you send the right size? I'm happy to send this one back.

Claire

subject: I was charged twice
body:
My card shows two charges of $2,149 for order RW-10508. I only ordered one bike. Please reverse the duplicate. I can forward the statement if you need it.

Diego

subject: Range on the City Step-Through?
body:
Not a complaint — I bought RW-10519 and it's on the way. What's the realistic range in eco mode for a 150 lb rider in a hilly city? The site says 40 miles and that feels optimistic.

Ruth

subject: Where is my order???
body:
You charged me last month and I never got a bike. I don't have the order number handy. My name might be under a different email. This is unacceptable. I want it delivered today or I want a full refund and I'll be talking to my lawyer.

S.
